decision_cycle: StoryBox computes actor-local visible state and legal actions.
Adapter converts visible state into StrategicObservation without backstage truth.
SCK updates actor-local BeliefState from visible evidence only.
SCK evaluates legal actions and returns StrategicDecision.
Optional language renderer realizes CommunicationIntent without changing chosen strategic action.
StoryBox re-validates the proposed action against current legal actions and authority.
StoryBox resolves simultaneous/colliding actions and hard-world uncertainty.
StoryBox writes back public/private information, resources, commitments, reputation, relationships, map and deadlines.
Evaluator may compare the recorded decision against backstage truth or oracle values only after the action has been fixed.
Storyteller may render the resolved trace but may not repair the decision or outcome.
forbidden: SCK reading fixed truth or evaluator oracle values before deciding
SCK directly mutating StoryBox world state
language renderer substituting a different strategic action
StoryBox replacing an SCK loss with a convenient literary outcome
cross-game confidential evidence entering SCK portfolio summaries without an explicit StoryBox bridge

rollout_boundary.v0: SCK uses an abstract rollout_utility callback over visible-state hypotheses and opponent response models.
rollout_boundary.future: MCTS/bi-level search may use a sandboxed StoryBox transition model, but rollout state is hypothetical and never written to canonical world state.
rollout_boundary.truth_rule: A rollout may condition on the actor's hidden-world hypotheses and probabilities, never on which hypothesis is actually true.
